_doc: Protection code: model-output validation/coercion, the hand-written correction turn and its prompt, lenient JSON extraction and fence stripping. Subtracted from core with `loc_count.py --core --no-guard`. Ranges are [start, end, reason]. Jac and NOOA carry no such lines: byLLM's schema-hint + correction retry and NOOA's PredictStrategy(max_retries) do this inside the framework (NOOA's max_retries=2 shares line 234 with temperature/max_tokens and is kept). Kept in every arm: the empty-question fan-in branch, the [:MAX_SCOUTS] clamp inlined in the field pickup, MIN/MAX_ROUNDS loop budgets, the Wikipedia 429 back-off and throttle (tool-side rate limiting), STANCES/LABELS tuples (the enum definitions).
FactCheck/LangGraph/fact_check.py: _FENCE_RE: strip ```json fences the model emits despite the prompt
parse_json_object: fence strip + lenient outermost-{...} extraction, raise when absent
structured_call: except -> correction prompt -> one retry call (byLLM does this in the runtime)
_enum: coerce/validate stance and label against the allowed set, raise otherwise
_text: coerce None/non-string reply fields to str
verifier.validate: coerce None/str sources, reject non-list
